note: Privately operated RV park on a wooded point of the Possum Creek embayment of Chickamauga Lake (Tennessee River), 1845 Lee Pike, Soddy-Daisy; boat ramp and swim area. No sewer hookups (a weekly septic pump-out service instead) and no tent camping. Leans long-stay: sites are billed weekly, with a discount for four weeks prepaid. --Claude

Google 4.1/133. Long-stay leaning (billed weekly); lakefront -> lakeview proposed (no named sites, pads ~4 m above summer pool).
flags: PRIVATE GATES: posted rate $40 a night including tax and power (operator's about.html rate table; the page carries no date, read live 2026-11-25) - under $50, no gateway needed. Presence: working operator site with phone + Google Maps open, 4.1 stars from 133 reviews, phone 423-332-8468. RV Life $ (stored). Google 4.1 is mediocre but over the 4.0 line.

LONG-STAY (report, not a drop on its own): the operator posts a nightly rate (test 2 passes) but leans long-stay - 'All sites are billed weekly. Discount available for prepayment of 4 weeks.' and 'Septic service comes out once a week and will empty black tank' (no sewer hookups); the old note said full-time residents are present. Booking is by phone only, so the nightly share can't be measured; Google review text was not shown to the logged-out browser. With Google 4.1, the reviewer may want to weigh it as borderline long-stay.

WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview PROPOSED (unsure -> down): no site numbers exist on any page (no map, no engine), so no named sites can be cited. Measured: the south-shore units sit 22-31 m from Chickamauga Lake but 4.0-4.5 m above it (3DEP pads 211.8-212.3 m vs lidar water 207.76 m / 208.0 m summer pool) over a ~14-18% dirt bank under scattered trees; west units are 40-100 m back in woods. The operator photo (sites-6) shows a shoreline row with the lake a few metres behind the pads, and Google's topic chips list 'waterfront lots' - so a re-audit lead if a site map turns up, but by the 4-6 m precedent (p3-590) and the no-named-sites rule it goes down.
